fixes.title: Subnautica + Nitrox (multiplayer)
fixes.description: Get Nitrox to load properly. The mod doesn't load via DLL proxy; instead, it uses NitroxPatcher and the mod's own launcher—a .NET 9 application. Without the runtime present in the prefix, it won't start, and the game launches in its vanilla state. This fix installs the .NET Desktop Runtime 9 into the prefix and configures the launch sequence to use the Nitrox launcher.
